name: EPIC 248761688
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 14, 13.7 solar radii and 0.84 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 3,271 parsecs away, 14 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 14, give 0.84 solar masses and 13.7 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,682 K at its surface.
